# Interstitials

Text reveal helpers for section transitions.

## What's here

- `text.js` - `introLines` (reveal by line) and `fadeInChars` (reveal by character), using GSAP SplitText

- [Choreography atoms](../choreography/atoms/README.md) - the newer text reveal
